query: What is the 2010 population of the city 2.1 miles southwest of Marietta Air Force Station?

pipeline_result.response: The 2010 population of the city 2.1 miles southwest of Marietta Air Force Station is 53,438.
retrieved_context: Smyrna, Georgia: Smyrna is a city northwest of the neighborhoods of Atlanta.  It is in the inner ring of the Atlanta Metropolitan Area.  As of the 2010 census, the city had a population of 51,271.  The U.S. Census Bureau estimated the population in 2013 to be 53,438.  It is included in the Atlanta-Sandy Springs-Roswell MSA, which is included in the Atlanta—Athens-Clarke—Sandy Springs CSA.  Smyrna grew by 28% between the years 2000 and 2012.  It is historically one of the fastest growing cities in the State of Georgia, and one of the most densely populated cities in the metro area.

Marietta Air Force Station: Marietta Air Force Station (ADC ID: M-111, NORAD ID: Z-111) is a closed United States Air Force General Surveillance Radar station.  It is located 2.1 mi northeast of Smyrna, Georgia.  It was closed in 1968.
